The committed public/ build output is not residue: solve.sh only does 'cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"' with no npm install or build, and server.js lines 130-131 serve path.join(root,'public'), so the bundle is the runtime deliverable; server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3, which environment/Dockerfile installs globally. Bundle is consistent with the shipped sources: all 62 distinctive string literals sampled from src/app.tsx, src/runtime.ts and src/custom-editor.js occur in public/assets/index.js, and public/assets/index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css. Counterexample probes tried: (a) stale or orphaned build output (bundle not matching src) - not found; (b) required file hidden as missing dotfile or wrong-level tools/ - not found, score.py sits exactly one level under tests/. Notes, none blocking: (1) public/runner.html duplicates static/runner.html byte for byte and public/assets/index.css duplicates src/style.css; both are the expected source/output pairs of vite.config.mjs (publicDir 'static', outDir 'public'), not backups. (2) public/assets/index.js is a 1.9 MB unminified generated bundle (minify:false), the largest file in the task; legitimate but generated. (3) tests/.dockerignore lists '__pycache__', and no such directory exists in the tree. (4) environment/assets/seed_data.json is a task-specific 149-byte seed with empty snippets; the workbook annotation and skill section 50 say a checker flag on a task-specific seed_data.json is a known false positive to be reported as Note. (5) The private check-required-files.py was not executed; this verdict rests on a manual diff of the tree against the closed list, and no Oracle, portal or checker result is claimed.
